extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: A fully authentic visual question answering dataset sourced from Stack Exchange online question answering community forums, featuring authentic questions, contexts, images, and user-validated answers across 105 topics with paragraph-length answers.
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by scraping publicly available archives from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange across 105 topical sites belonging to five super-categories. Examples were gathered if they contained four components: a natural language question (title), a natural language context (body), an image (URL link), and an accepted answer marked by the question asker.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Visual questions where images could not be downloaded from the provided links were removed, reducing the count from 65,849 to 64,696.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Publicly available Stack Exchange data archive hosted at https://archive.org/details/stackexchange in XML format spanning August 2010 to November 2022.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: All downloaded images were converted to PNG format for data format consistency.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtered candidate visual questions through several steps: removed questions without an accepted answer; removed posts with an up-vote/down-vote score of 0 or less for either question or answer; excluded questions with multiple images or visual answers; excluded 75 technology topics (e.g., Stack Overflow, LaTeX) because they primarily focus on code in screenshots; and removed entries where the image could not be downloaded.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For user intentions, crowdworkers categorized visual questions into eight intent categories (advice, evidence, identification, instruction, opinion, reason, verification, other). For human evaluation of models, ten domain experts evaluated model-generated answers on a custom web interface, labeling them as incorrect (0), partially correct (0.5), or correct (1).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (for user intention annotation) and a custom web-based interface hosted at https://github.com/VQAonline/VQAonlineVisualization (for domain expert model evaluation)
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For user intentions, two annotators independently labeled items; in 25 out of 105 cases with disagreement, a third annotator broke the tie via majority vote. Agreement accuracy and Cohen's kappa were measured during taxonomy design over 4 rounds, reaching 87.5% accuracy and 84.69% kappa.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 2 to 3 annotators per item for user intention annotations; 1 domain expert per item for the human evaluation study (evaluating 6 model outputs across 200 VQAs).
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Crowdworkers were located in the United States with over 500 completed HITs and a >95% approval rating. Domain experts were located in the United States, each possessing at least a Master's degree in a field related to their assigned VQA topic.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Expected to benefit real-world applications including community question answering platforms, learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, and visual search/browsing.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may poorly represent individuals in poverty-stricken areas due to the requirement of internet and mobile device access. The geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced, with heavy representation from countries like the US, India, and European nations, and lower representation from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Geographic and socio-economic biases due to Stack Exchange user demographics; high prevalence of screenshots (79-84%) and digital-realm queries; long-tail topic distribution where 52% of VQAs come from 24 science topics; standard short-answer VQA metrics fail due to lengthy answers (mean 173 words).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, and Validation for visual question answering (VQA) models, especially long-form answer generation, few-shot learning, and multimodal reasoning.
